ownership.center_registration: FND-03 owns pages/shell center registration; page tasks only submit route fragment

global_rules.chain_formal_app_migration: APP migrated page -> MAPP server -> original business data/service
global_rules.chain_wish_native: APP -> Wish APP BFF -> Wish API/application service -> DDD -> Wish DB/Outbox/Event (GOV-03 must not attach Wish BFF/DDD)
global_rules.query: query params round-trip verbatim; unknown params preserved-for-drop-decision but never trusted for auth
global_rules.attribution: scene/source/activity_id/content_id preserved on share/qrcode/deep-link re-entry; token/health-data must never be encoded in link
global_rules.return_stack: back navigation returns to recorded shell entry; on failure fail-closed to APP native page
global_rules.share_qrcode_deeplink: share inflow keeps source/activity/content id; qrcode carries only short-lived public business reference; webview content only via host allowlist, no raw identity token injection
global_rules.login_recovery: unauthenticated deep link stores pending link (opaque, route-allowlisted), restores after APP one-time login (IDN-01 session/bridge boundary, formal pages call MAPP per original contract, not via Wish bridge); logout/revoke/expire/replay/over-privilege fail-closed with minimal desensitized audit to APP native page or login
global_rules.invalid_rejection: unknown route, non-allowlisted origin/host, missing/invalid required param, token-or-health-data in link, expired qrcode/scene are rejected fail-closed with explicit error, never auto-created as new business route
global_rules.legacy_fallback: feature flag default legacy; switch only by automated route check; flag-off falls back to legacy alias; formal pages handled by APP center route; history-only via audited short-term adapter or safe external link
global_rules.fail_closed_audit: replay/expired/revoked/over-privilege/site-mismatch/bridge-failure fail closed with minimal desensitized audit
global_rules.no_write_master_change: routing fallback is never interpreted as backend write-master switch; Wish/Commerce authoritative write-masters unchanged
global_rules.third_party_excluded: three third-party mini-program buttons on APP home only launch external mini-programs; not migration lanes, not connected to MAPP server, no registry entry
global_rules.no_auth_tasks: no new or modified AUTH tasks (admin login/session/token/credentials out of scope)
